title: Lockheed Martin and U.S. Navy Demonstrate AI-Powered Submarine Hunter at RIMPAC 2026
summary: Lockheed Martin, in collaboration with the U.S. Navy, successfully demonstrated an AI/ML sonar expert system called SensorMAX™ for anti-submarine warfare (ASW) at RIMPAC 2026. This system monitors subsurface acoustic data to assist crews with rapid threat detection and features over-the-air model update capability.

title: China’s Reusable Space Launch Booster Recoveries Have Major Military Implications
summary: China's successful recoveries of reusable space launch boosters, akin to SpaceX's Falcon 9, carry significant military implications. This capability could diminish a key U.S. advantage in space access for both national security and commercial applications.
